verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say you can register an HTTPS webhook endpoint and Stripe then pushes real-time event data to it, covering events such as payment confirmations, disputes and recurring payments. Event destinations add Amazon EventBridge and Azure Event Grid targets with snapshot or thin event formats. For agent-driven setup, the MCP server can create webhook endpoints and the Workbench Shell supports `stripe listen` for local event testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, plus documentation of signature verification and retry behaviour.
